Description: Discover exceptional space, privacy, and comfort in this beautifully maintained Meadowbrook residence, ideally situated on an oversized estate lot at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. Surrounded by lush tropical landscaping, this impressive home offers 4 bedrooms plus a versatile den or optional fifth bedroom, 3 full bathrooms, and a spacious 3-car garage. The desirable split-bedroom floor plan provides privacy, with the primary suite conveniently located on the main level, featuring a luxurious soaking tub, separate glass-enclosed shower, and generous California-style closet. The upstairs bonus room, complete with a walk-in closet, offers additional flexibility for guests, a home office, or recreational space. The inviting kitchen features an island, Corian countertops, pantry, and stainless steel appliances, while the utility room provides additional built-in storage. Step outside to your own private tropical retreat, where a sparkling pool and spa are surrounded by an expansive screened lanai, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Notable improvements include a NEW ROOF IN 2023, electric hurricane shutters, updated pool equipment, and interior and exterior painting. Located WEST OF US-41, Meadowbrook offers convenient access to Coconut Point Mall, exceptional dining, shopping, and Southwest Florida’s beautiful beaches. With LOW HOA FEES and an outstanding location, this property delivers the perfect combination of privacy, spacious living, and the Southwest Florida lifestyle!

Description: Discover the ultimate Florida waterfront lifestyle in this spacious and beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence, ideally situated just off the Spreader Canal. Thoughtfully cared for and inviting throughout, this home offers a seamless blend of comfortable living and exceptional outdoor enjoyment. The true highlight is the spectacular outdoor oasis, designed for both relaxation and entertaining, featuring a stunningly appointed swimming pool, an inviting outdoor bar, and ample space within the pool cage to enjoy year-round. Boating enthusiasts will appreciate the expansive canal frontage, 13,000-pound boat lift, and wraparound dock, providing the perfect setting to embrace life on the water. Whether hosting gatherings with friends, enjoying a peaceful afternoon poolside, or heading out for a day on the boat, this property delivers the very best of the Southwest Florida lifestyle. With its exceptional waterfront amenities and beautifully maintained interior, this home is the perfect place to experience the Florida dream.

This beautiful, impeccably maintained canal front two-story Beacon home is the total package - nearly 5000 square feet of living space featuring an open Great Room plan, 4 ensuite bedrooms plus den, 5.5 bath, and 2 large flex spaces. High level interior features include marble wall in Great Room, lighted woodwork, quartz tops, ceramic flooring, and designer ceilings. The gourmet chef’s kitchen is a culinary dream including gas slide in range, dual wall ovens with convection microwave, lighted transom cabinetry, spice drawers, utensil organizer, and spacious walk-in pantry. Primary bedroom conveniently located on the first floor. A separate upstairs living space includes a kitchenette, 2 full baths, large entertainment/living room, and a spacious ensuite bedroom - perfect for guests or family. Step outside to your private oasis featuring travertine lanai, 16’x34’ pool, and infinity spa with gas and electric heat. Pool area is enhanced by waterfall bowls, fountains, sundeck jets, and beautiful Southern exposure views of palm trees and your private boat dock in the canal, ready for your boat or kayak. Upgraded outdoor kitchen complete with sink, grill, and mini fridge. This home is storm-ready and efficient with impact windows and doors, Storm Smart shutters, whole house generator, and solar panels that significantly reduce energy bills. The 3 car garage has mini split AC, EV outlet, and overhead storage. Additional premium upgrades include power window treatments, recently painted exterior, crown molding, color changing fireplace, and premium speaker system. Esplanade Lake Club includes top tier amenities including pickleball, bocce, tennis, resort pool, and lakefront access. The fitness center is a 3,000 square feet facility equipped with state-of-the-art Technogym equipment. Members love the live music nights at the Bahama Bar and Grill, and mornings at the Toasted Cafe. And, Signature Events are planned throughout the year offering one of a kind themes and cuisine personalized especially for the members. Esplanade is located near numerous dining and shopping destinations.

Description:
Welcome to this beautifully appointed 3-bedroom + den, 2-bath coach home in the highly desirable Cherry Oaks Village. Perfectly positioned to capture stunning golf course and tranquil water views, this residence offers an exceptional blend of comfort, style, and location. Enjoy breathtaking western exposure from the expansive lanai, where you'll take in unforgettable sunset views each evening. The home also benefits from additional southern exposure along the side, enhanced by its prime positioning next to the community pool--allowing for abundant natural light without obstruction from neighboring buildings. The close proximity to the satellite pool adds an extra layer of convenience, making it feel like your own private retreat. Inside, the home features engineered hardwood flooring in all bedrooms and the den, complemented by tile throughout the main living areas for a clean and cohesive look. For added peace of mind and comfort, the property is equipped with dual automatic screens, including both durable metal shutters and sun shades--providing protection, privacy, and ease of use.
This is a rare opportunity to enjoy scenic views, exceptional natural light, and an unbeatable location within one of the community's most sought-after neighborhoods. The award-winning, resort style community of Fiddler's Creek is enhanced by a club and spa, fitness center, swimming pools, two golf courses, tennis courts, pickleball courts, a bocce court, fine and casual dining, social activities, and miles of biking and walking paths. Optional beach club and marina memberships are available. Experience the epitome of luxury living, where every detail is thoughtfully curated to complement your lifestyle.

Imagine waking to morning light dancing across the canal, savoring coffee beside the pool, and ending the day entertaining under your covered lanai. Welcome to 817 NW 38th Ave, a BRAND-NEW 2026 luxury Gulf-access residence where architecture, comfort, and the Southwest Florida waterfront lifestyle come together.

Spanning 2,448 square feet with 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a den, and a 3-car garage, the home makes a memorable entrance with its striking facade, paver driveway, and elegant exterior lighting. Inside, Venetian plaster accentuates the entry and custom TV entertainment wall. Tray ceilings with soft cove lighting, large-format tile flooring, streamlined linear AC vents, designer lighting, and dramatic black-framed sliding glass doors create an inviting, contemporary atmosphere. Remote-controlled zebra blinds dress the windows and patio doors, while hanging bedside pendants bring boutique-hotel style to the bedrooms.

Designed for gathering, the great room opens to a kitchen featuring contrasting cabinetry, a generous island, walk-in pantry, wall oven, pot filler, and wine cooler. Expansive sliding doors connect the living spaces to the pool and canal beyond.

The primary suite is a serene retreat with two walk-in closets featuring custom cabinetry and glass doors. Its spa-inspired bathroom offers a multi-jet shower with a waterfall-style rain shower, separate jetted soaking tub, dual sinks, and the convenience of smart toilets throughout the home.

Outside, enjoy a spacious paver pool deck, electrically heated pool, and raised mosaic-tiled spa, framed by views of a wide waterfront canal. The covered outdoor living area features a warm wood-look ceiling, ceiling fan, and built-in outdoor kitchen, perfect for relaxed afternoons or memorable evenings with friends. An outdoor shower, screened enclosure, east-facing rear exposure, and bridge-restricted Gulf access complete the waterfront experience. Impact-resistant windows and doors, a tile roof, and no HOA fees add practical appeal.

The location makes this opportunity even more compelling. Northwest Cape Coral is welcoming exciting new amenities, including the newly opened Tropicana Park with waterfront recreation and kayak access. Nearby Sirenia Vista Park offers opportunities to explore nature, watch manatees, and enjoy the area's waterways. The planned Seven Islands Gulf Gateway Resort & Marina Village is envisioned to introduce waterfront dining, shopping, hospitality, and public recreational spaces, while the Cape Coral Grove development along Pine Island Road is planned to bring additional shopping, restaurants, and entertainment to the area.

This is more than a beautifully designed new home. It's an opportunity to enjoy waterfront living, exceptional comfort, and a growing Southwest Florida community, all from a place you'll love coming home to.

Description:
A BOATER'S PARADISE, CAR COLLECTOR'S DREAM & TROPICAL OASIS—ALL IN ONE EXTRAORDINARY WATERFRONT PROPERTY! Welcome to 2105 Ottersrest Lane, a custom-built Cat 5 home situated on a corner waterfront lot at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac. Offering DIRECT GULF ACCESS, breathtaking preserve views, exceptional garage space, and lush, pesticide-free landscaping, this one-of-a-kind property delivers the ultimate Southwest Florida lifestyle!

BOATERS, THIS ONE IS FOR YOU! Enjoy deep-water, SAILBOAT ACCESS with NO BRIDGES and reach the Caloosahatchee River in approximately FIVE MINUTES! Your private waterfront retreat features a composite dock, sunrise-facing Captain's Walk overlooking The Preserve at Four Mile Cove, remote-controlled 16,000-lb boat lift with 34' canopy, and a remote-operated kayak platform convertible to a jet ski lift. Whether cruising the Gulf or enjoying spectacular sunrises, waterfront living doesn't get much better!

CAR ENTHUSIASTS & HOBBYISTS WILL LOVE THIS! The attached 862 sq ft THREE-CAR GARAGE is fully climate-controlled with its own mini-split system. The adjacent lot features a BRAND-NEW 560 sq ft DETACHED WORKSHOP with 14' ceilings, oversized 14' x 12' door, and dedicated 200-amp electrical service. A rare opportunity for collectors, recreational toys, or workshop enthusiasts—with plenty of green space remaining!

Inside, discover 2,032 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space featuring 3 BEDROOMS, 2 BATHROOMS, and a beautifully REMODELED KITCHEN with an oversized baker's island, built-in microwave, and mixer cabinet. Expansive corner sliding glass doors open the living area to a spectacular 1,040 sq ft SCREENED LANAI and PROPANE-HEATED SALTWATER POOL, creating effortless indoor-outdoor living and entertaining.

EXTENSIVE UPGRADES & PEACE OF MIND! Major improvements include a STONE-COATED STEEL ROOF, whole-house A/C, tankless propane water heater, updated pool pump and heater, LED pool lighting, whole-house water softener, and reverse osmosis drinking water system. Storm preparedness includes a 12,000-watt dual-fuel generator supported by a 250-gallon underground propane tank and utility meter connection. The home has NEVER FLOODED and features underground utilities.

Step outside into your own GOLD CERTIFIED FLORIDA-FRIENDLY TROPICAL SANCTUARY! This pesticide-free landscape attracts birds and butterflies while an established orchard produces MANGO, AVOCADO, PAPAYA, BANANA, and LEMON! Smart irrigation, rainwater collection, and WiFi-enabled outdoor controls add convenience and sustainability.

TWO LOTS, DIRECT GULF ACCESS, INCREDIBLE GARAGE SPACE & YOUR OWN TROPICAL PARADISE! An exceptional combination that's nearly impossible to duplicate! Floor plans, elevation certificate, and detailed property features are available. Schedule your private showing today!

BEAUTIFUL LAKE JUNE WATERFRONT HOME!
Enjoy resort-style lakefront living at its best with this beautiful home located directly on Lake June in Lake Placid, Florida. With plenty of space for family and friends, this property is perfect for weekend getaways, family gatherings or simply relaxing by the water.
One of the many great features of this property is its incredible waterfront setting, complete with a large private dock, multi-level covered boathouse with three boat lift areas, an upper sun deck and plenty of space to sit back and enjoy the lake views.
Outdoor fun is endless with a sandy beach, waterfront firepit, putting green, in-water volleyball, outdoor shower and plenty of room for swimming, boating, fishing and water sports.
Inside, you’ll find an open floor plan with vaulted ceilings, a spacious kitchen featuring quartz countertops and a large island perfect for entertaining, comfortable living areas and plenty of room for guests. The home features three bedrooms, three bathrooms and a bonus loft that offers the perfect space for a bunk room, game room or additional gathering area. A large screened lanai overlooking the lake provides the perfect spot for morning coffee, outdoor dining or watching the sunset.
The property also features a metal roof, a large fenced side lot with plenty of space for trailer parking, and a large raised vegetable garden. With room for both recreation and relaxation, this waterfront home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience and outdoor living.
Whether you’re looking for a peaceful waterfront getaway or a place to make lasting memories with family and friends, this Lake June home has it all. Come see for yourself what makes this property so special!

Video and audio recording on premises.

OVER $300,000 IN BUILDER UPGRADES, an EXPANSIVE OUTDOOR RETREAT, and an OVERSIZED LOT distinguish this LIKE-NEW REVERENCE floor plan at 6262 Glory Lane in DEL WEBB NAPLES, a 55+ COMMUNITY in AVE MARIA. BUILT IN 2025, this beautifully appointed home offers 3 BR+DEN, 3 FULL BATH, and 2,716 SQFT of living space. Situated NEAR A CUL-DE-SAC on approximately 0.24 ACRES, the property also benefits from an easement along one side, adding separation from the neighboring home.

WOOD-PLANK TILE flows throughout, complemented by UPGRADED LIGHT FIXTURES & CEILING FANS. The kitchen showcases UPGRADED LEVEL 4 WHITE CABINETRY paired with an ADMIRAL-COLORED WRAPPED ISLAND, LEVEL 5 QUARTZ COUNTERTOPS, and a MATCHING QUARTZ BACKSPLASH for a seamless look without grout lines. BUILT-IN KITCHENAID APPLIANCES, a BEVERAGE COOLER, and UNDERCABINET LIGHTING complete this thoughtfully upgraded space.

POCKET SLIDING GLASS DOORS open the gathering room to an impressive screened outdoor living area. The NEARLY 1,300-SQFT ENCLOSURE features PICTURE-FRAME SCREENING, approximately 1,021 SQFT OF BRICK PAVERS, and a 10-BY-24-FOOT POOL & SPA and WATERFALL FEATURES. A 370-SQFT COVERED LANAI provides additional room for outdoor dining and lounging, while a POOL-ACCESS BATHROOM adds convenience. The lanai is also PREPPED FOR AN OUTDOOR KITCHEN, with electrical outlets, a vent, and plumbing connections in place for future installation.

The bathrooms feature CUSTOM MIRRORS and SHOWERS WITH CEILING-HEIGHT WAVY WHITE ICE BRIGHT WALL TILE and FRAMELESS HEAVY DUTY GLASS DOORS. The primary bathroom includes a WALK-IN SHOWER. Additional highlights include IMPACT WINDOWS AND DOORS, an EPOXY-COATED GARAGEFLOOR, and a 2-CAR GARAGE WITH A SEPARATE GOLF CART BAY.

Enjoy access to Del Webb Naples’ resort-style amenities, with OPTIONAL GOLF MEMBERSHIPS available for golf enthusiasts, along with the shopping, dining, and community activities of Ave Maria. Ave Maria: where community meets paradise.
